description: React component implementing a GraphQL IDE using GraphiQL and GraphiQL Explorer, with dynamic schema fetching and URL parameter handling.

methods.name: getIntrospectionUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the introspection URL from the DOM element with id 'graphiql'.

methods.name: fetcher
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to the introspection URL with provided GraphQL parameters.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that renders GraphiQL interface with schema introspection and URL parameter management.

methods.name: parseQueryFromUrl
methods.description: Parses query parameters from the URL to initialize GraphQL query and variables.

methods.name: updateURL
methods.description: Updates the browser URL with current query parameters.

methods.name: handleEditQuery
methods.description: Handles editing of the GraphQL query, updating URL accordingly.

methods.name: handleToggleExplorer
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the GraphiQL Explorer panel.

methods.name: onEditVariables
methods.description: Handles editing of GraphQL variables, updating URL accordingly.

methods.name: onEditOperationName
methods.description: Handles editing of the GraphQL operation name, updating URL accordingly.
